summary: Review replication and reproducibility studies for target-effect fidelity, analytic equivalence, deviations and whether success or failure claims exceed the replication design.

must_inspect.why: A replication must identify which original estimand, endpoint and population it is attempting to reproduce.
false_positive_guards: Conceptual replications may intentionally change operationalization; judge whether the claim acknowledges that boundary.

must_inspect.why: Differences in materials, population, setting or analysis can explain divergence and should be separated from the replication outcome itself.
false_positive_guards: A deviation is not automatically fatal; assess whether it changes the targeted inference.

must_inspect.why: A non-significant result alone is not equivalent to evidence of no effect, and a significant result alone is not full replication.
false_positive_guards: Use the inferential criterion the replication design actually prespecified when available.
Do not reduce replication to p-value agreement.
